name: SDF Texture Baking for Ray Marching
aliases: 3D SDF Baking for Cloud Sphere Tracing
definition: A technique to optimize cloud raymarching by baking a low-resolution 3D Signed Distance Field (SDF) texture that acts as a conservative proxy for the analytical cloud SDF, allowing the marching loop to skip empty space conservatively before falling back to analytical evaluations inside active cells.
summary: SDF Texture Baking for Ray Marching optimizes cloud rendering by baking a conservative 3D SDF proxy to skip empty space, decoupling query cost from frame rate for interactive performance.
